title: 202. Single-Threaded CPU

examples.explanation: The events go as follows: at time 1 task 0 is available, CPU processes it until time 3. At time 3 tasks 1 and 2 are available, CPU picks task 2 (shorter). At time 5 task 3 is available with tasks 1, CPU picks task 3 (shortest), then task 1.
All tasks are available at time 7. CPU picks them in order of processing time, breaking ties by index.

hints: Sort tasks by enqueue time, then simulate the CPU clock, pushing newly available tasks into a min-heap.
The heap orders by (processingTime, index) so the CPU always picks the shortest available task.
When the heap is empty, jump the clock forward to the next enqueue time.
